Leadership

Our Board of Directors and Executive Committee work together to set and deliver Smiths goals and strategy and shape our culture. Together they are responsible for the long-term success of our company.

NC RC CC
Steve Williams
Chairman
Steve Williams
Chairman
Appointed: 1 September 2023

Skills and experience: Steve has over 40 years of global experience, most recently as Chairman and CEO of international businesses. Steve brings a clear focus on ESG matters and has a strong track record of growth and transformation and in creating value for customers, shareholders, employees and communities as both an executive and non-executive director. Steve has a BSc in Engineering.

Career experience: Steve was previously a non-executive director at TC Energy Corporation. Steve served as an advisory Board member of Canada’s Ecofiscal Commission and a Board member of the business council of Canada until 2019. He served as Chief Executive Officer of Suncor Energy Inc., the US and Canadian listed integrated energy company, from 2012 to 2019 and as President from 2011 to 2018. Steve spent the first 18 years of his career at ExxonMobil in the UK, in a variety of commercial, operational, and technical roles.

Roland Carter
Chief Executive Officer
Roland Carter
Chief Executive Officer
Appointed: 26 March 2024

Skills and experience: Roland has a strong track record of innovation, sustainability and delivering results, with deep operational and strategic experience developed over three decades at Smiths. He has extensive international experience, having worked in France, Germany, the US and China. Roland is a Chartered Engineer, holding both a Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering and a Master’s degree in electronics.

Career experience: Prior to Roland’s appointment as Chief Executive Officer, he had been with Smiths Group for more than 30 years, holding numerous leadership roles within the business. Before being appointed Chief Executive Officer, Roland was President of Smiths Detection, President of Asia Pacific for Smiths Group and President of Smiths Interconnect.

Role Profile - Chief Executive
Julian Fagge
Chief Financial Officer
Julian Fagge
Chief Financial Officer
Appointed: 1 February 2025

Skills and experience: Julian is a highly experienced leader, with a strong focus on value accretion and growth. He is experienced in strategy development, M&A and finance. Julian has an MA from the University of Edinburgh and is a Chartered Accountant qualified with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Scotland.

Career experience: Prior to becoming CFO, Julian was President of Smiths Interconnect. He joined Smiths as Group Financial Controller in July 2013 and was appointed to Group Strategy and M&A Director in October 2017 and appointed CEO of Flex-Tek in 2019. Prior to Smiths, he spent two years at Royal Caribbean Cruises as Finance Director for UK Ireland and prior to that, he worked for 12 years at Procter & Gamble, based predominantly in Geneva, Switzerland.

Pam Cheng
Non-executive director
Pam Cheng
Non-executive director
Appointed: 1 March 2020

Skills and experience: Pam’s experience in the areas of R&D, manufacturing, sales and marketing, commercial operations, supply chain management and technology strengthen the Board’s discussions about embedding world-class operations. Pam holds a Bachelor of Science and a Master’s degree in chemical engineering from Stevens Institute of Technology, New Jersey and an MBA in Marketing from Pace University, New York.

Career experience: Pam is Executive Vice President, Global Operations, IT & Chief Sustainability Officer at AstraZeneca plc, a multinational pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical company. Pam assumed additional responsibility for the AstraZeneca sustainability strategy and function in January 2023. Prior to joining AstraZeneca in 2015, Pam was President of MSD (Merck & Co., Inc.) in China. Pam previously held various engineering and project management positions at Universal Oil Products, Union Carbide Corporation and GAF Chemicals.

Alister Cowan
Non-executive Director
Alister Cowan
Non-executive Director
Appointed: 1 July 2024

Skills and experience: Alister has experience at complex global public companies and brings deep and wide-ranging experience in key end markets for Smiths, notably in the energy and chemical sectors. Alister is a graduate of Heriot-Watt University in the UK and a member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Scotland, having qualified whilst at KPMG.

Career experience: Alister was Chief Financial Officer of Suncor Energy Inc., the US and Canadian listed integrated energy company, from 2014 to 2023. Prior to joining Suncor, Alister served as Chief Financial Officer of Husky Energy Inc. from 2008 to 2014. Before joining Husky Energy, he held various positions with companies throughout Europe, New Zealand and Canada.

Dame Ann Dowling
Senior Independent Director
Dame Ann Dowling
Senior Independent Director
Appointed: 19 September 2018

Skills and experience: Dame Ann is internationally recognised for her contribution to engineering research. Her knowledge and background in engineering, innovation and sustainability offer a different perspective to Board discussions. Dame Ann has a degree in Mathematics and a PhD in Engineering.

Career experience: Dame Ann has had a distinguished academic career and currently holds the position of Deputy Vice Chancellor and Emeritus Professor of Mechanical Engineering at the University of Cambridge. She served as Head of Engineering for five years until 2014. Additionally, Dame Ann was the President and Chairman of Trustees of The Royal Academy of Engineering from 2014 to 2019. She also served as Non-executive Director of BP plc from 2012 to 2021, where she was a member of the Safety and Sustainability Committee.

Dr. Emma FitzGerald
Non-executive Director
Dr. Emma FitzGerald
Non-executive Director
Appointed: 1 November 2026

Skills and experience: Emma brings international leadership and governance experience across the energy, industrials and infrastructure sectors, spanning plc and privately owned structures. Her expertise includes operational leadership, customer led innovation, business transformation, energy transition and the oversight of large, capital-intensive businesses. She has led major international operations and brings listed company board experience as an executive and non-executive director. She is also an accredited Executive Coach supporting the leadership development of global Senior Executives in plc and private equity businesses.

Career experience: Emma is currently a Non-executive Director of Seplat Energy plc, Newmont Corporation and the National Energy System Operator. Emma was previously Chief Executive Officer of Puma Energy International, Executive Director, Operations at Severn Trent plc, and Chief Executive Officer, Gas Distribution at National Grid plc. She has also held non-executive director roles at a range of listed companies including Graphene Manufacturing Group, UPM Kymmene Oyi, DCC plc and Cookson Group plc. Earlier in her career, she spent over 20 years with Shell in research and development, strategy, marketing and general management roles across Europe, North America and Asia including China.

Richard Howes
Non-executive Director
Richard Howes
Non-executive Director
Appointed: 1 September 2022

Skills and experience: Richard brings valuable insight to Board discussions, drawing on his extensive experience in senior financial roles across various sectors within large, listed companies. He holds a BSc in Geography from Loughborough University and is a Fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales (ICAEW). 

Career experience: Richard currently serves as Chief Financial Officer of Bunzl plc, the specialist international distribution and services Group. Richard qualified as a Charted Accountant with Ernst & Young before moving to the investment bank Dresdner Kleinwort Benson. Prior to joining Bunzl in 2019, Richard held CFO positions at various multinational businesses including Inchcape plc, Coats Group plc and Bakkavor plc.

Laurence Mulliez
Non-executive Director
Laurence Mulliez
Non-executive Director
Appointed: 1 September 2026

Skills and experience: Laurence brings extensive experience across listed international businesses, alongside a strong track record of driving performance and growth in global industrial and energy sectors. Her governance, strategic and sustainability expertise provides valuable perspective to the Board, while her international outlook and deep understanding of complex, capital intensive businesses are highly relevant as Smiths continues to execute its strategy.

Career experience: Laurence is currently a Non executive Director of Siemens Energy AG. She began her career at BNP Paribas before going on to hold a number of senior executive roles at BP across the USA, Switzerland and the UK, including Global Chief Executive Officer of Castrol Industrial Lubricants. She later served as Chief Executive Officer of Eoxis, an independent renewable energy producer, from 2010 to 2013. Since 2011, Laurence has built extensive non-executive experience across listed industrial and energy companies, including serving as Chair of Voltalia SA until May 2026 and as a Non-executive Director of Morgan Advanced Materials plc between 2016 and 2024.

Simon Pryce
Non-executive Director
Simon Pryce
Non-executive Director
Appointed: 1 February 2025

Skills and experience: Simon is a highly experienced business leader of customer focused, global, industrial manufacturing and service businesses, with a strong track record of value creation. He has held several Chief Executive Officer positions at listed companies with direct experience of Smiths Group’s key end markets, customers and supply chains. Simon is a Chartered Accountant.

Career experience: Simon is the Chief Executive of RS Group plc, a FTSE listed, digitally enabled, global distributor of product and service solutions for process industry maintenance, repair and operation’s needs. He was appointed into the role in April 2023. Prior to that he was Chief Executive of Ultra Electronics Holdings plc between 2018 and 2022 and Chief Executive of BBA Aviation plc between 2007 and 2018. He was a non-executive Director of RS Group from 2016 and Remuneration Committee Chairman from 2020 until his appointment as CEO.

Val Rahmani
Non-executive Director
Val Rahmani
Non-executive Director
Appointed: 1 October 2026

Skills and experience: Val brings significant international leadership, technology and governance experience, with expertise in cyber security, AI, digital transformation, risk management and strategy. This has been gained through executive and non-executive roles in global businesses, together with experience of major strategic transactions and business transformation.

Career experience: Val is currently a Non-executive Director of London Stock Exchange Group plc, where she serves on the Nomination, Remuneration and Risk Committees, and of RenaissanceRe Holdings Ltd and Entrust Corporation. She was previously a Non-executive Director of Aberdeen Asset Management and Computer Task Group. Earlier in her executive career, Val spent more than 25 years with IBM in senior leadership roles, before serving as Chief Executive Officer of Damballa.

Ruben Álvarez
President, John Crane
Ruben Álvarez
President, John Crane

Ruben was appointed President of John Crane in February 2025. Since joining John Crane in 1998, Ruben has led leadership teams in many regions across the globe including the Middle East & Africa, Asia Pacific, Europe and Americas, gaining significant experience in strategy, market development, operations and growth acceleration. His most recent roles include Executive Vice President of Sales and Aftermarket, Divisional Vice President of Strategy, Portfolios and Marketing and Divisional Vice President, Portfolios and Customer Operations.

James Down
General Counsel & Company Secretary
James Down
General Counsel & Company Secretary
Appointed: 1 June 2023

James Down joined Smiths Group in December 2016 as Head of M&A Legal. He was appointed General Counsel, Corporate in 2018 and subsequently appointed General Counsel for Smiths Detection in 2021. He was appointed General Counsel for the Group in June 2023. Prior to joining Smiths, James served as senior counsel at former FTSE 100 constituent SABMiller and before that spent his early career at international law firm, Hogan Lovells.

Chris Edwards
President of Flex-Tek Construction & Thermal Solutions
Chris Edwards
President of Flex-Tek Construction & Thermal Solutions

Chris brings a wealth of experience and expertise to his role as President of Flex-Tek Construction & Thermal Solutions, a position he assumed in September 2025. With 25 years of experience in the manufacturing sector, Chris has a proven track record of driving operational improvements and fostering business growth, both organically and through acquisition. His career at Smiths began in 2005 as Manufacturing Manager for the Thermaflex business unit. He has progressively advanced through various leadership roles within Flex-Tek, including Operations Manager, Divisional Operations Manager, General Manager, and Vice President. Before joining Smiths, Chris made significant contributions at Fuji Photo Film, Inc. Chris is recognised for his strong relationships within the construction industry and his talent for developing team members and building organisational depth.

Kini Pathmanathan
Chief People, Sustainability & Excellence Officer
Kini Pathmanathan
Chief People, Sustainability & Excellence Officer

Kini was appointed Chief People, Sustainability & Excellence Officer in February 2025. Kini joined Smiths in 2017, and she has previously served as Head of Smiths Excellence & Sustainability, VP of HR for John Crane, and VP of HR for Smiths Detection and Smiths Asia. Before joining Smiths, Kini was VP of HR at Thales UK. Kini has more than 25 years of experience working in matrixed advanced technology environments. She is an accomplished business leader with significant experience in continuous improvement, change and transformation, and has led teams across the USA, Latin America, EMEA and APAC. 

Mike Stern
President of Flex-Tek Aerospace
Mike Stern
President of Flex-Tek Aerospace

Mike was appointed President of Flex-Tek Aerospace in September 2025. Mike joined Smiths in 2019 as part of Smiths acquisition of United Flexible and has led the Aerospace business unit within Flex-Tek since the acquisition.  Mike has 35 years of experience in the aerospace industry and in 2004 was appointed CEO of a small, publicly traded aerospace company, Kreisler Manufacturing prior to its sale to a private equity firm.  Mike has experience in all aspects of the industry with significant experience in continuous improvement, manufacturing operations and business development.
